description: The output contract for a compilation: the files a compilation must contain, the schema each must satisfy, and the checks across files that no schema language can express. A specification pins every file in this folder by git commit in its contract list, so later edits here do not change what a published specification requires.

files.part: YAML front matter between the first two --- lines, then a non-empty Markdown body

files.each: one per target book of the specification

crossChecks.rule: manifest.json, REPORT.md and every book file name the same specification ULID and compilation ULID, and those match the compilation's folder.
The statement in manifest.json and in each book's editionStmt is exactly: This compilation was produced under Open Lexis Transcription Specification <specification ULID>.
manifest.json specification.file is the specification's path and specification.sha256 is the SHA-256 of that file.
manifest.json specification.license equals the specification's license field, and each book's licence has target = its url and text "<copyright>. Licensed under <name>."
manifest.json lists every target book of the specification and nothing else, each book's file exists, and its sha256 and bytes match the file.
manifest.json totals equal the sums over books, and REPORT.md totals equal manifest.json totals.
The model attribution (provider, model family, model name, model id, effort level, harness) and the creation time are the same in manifest.json and REPORT.md.
Every #pointer in a wit, corresp, target, attested or lacuna note points at an xml:id in the same file; witness pointers point at a witness in listWit.

In REPORT.md, disagreement_scale max is greater than min and every subcategory level is between them; in each book, every severity note's n is between min and max and its subtype is a declared subcategory id.
No em dash (U+2014) appears in manifest.json, REPORT.md or any book file.
